# Components

Each page is at `{docs}/docs/{framework}/{section}/{slug}.md`, where the framework is `react`, `solid`, `vue`, `svelte`
or `web`. Import from the entry in the Import column, never from the package root. The Web column says whether
`@ark-ui/web` ships it.
